copy.heading: The window observation
body: The subject will be observed at the kitchen window between seven and nine in the morning, holding a mug, looking at the garden. This is not planning. No plan results from it.
The behaviour is understood to be a form of negotiation with an opponent who does not know the negotiation is happening.
Inspectors should note that the garden is winning, and has been winning since March.
